email.body1:
Timothy, saw Cirrus rolled out a new power-efficient LED line that saves customers around $7,000 over ten years.

A product launch with that kind of hook usually opens more SMB accounts than the team can cover before the new motion ramps, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Cirrus off your hiring and tech-stack signals, accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Timothy, quick follow-up for Cirrus.

In high-volume SMB, the new product means more accounts to work than reps can personally touch. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Cirrus needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Timothy, last bit of proof for Cirrus.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Cirrus's reply rate likely compares to similar teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
